home.daily_body: You now have {n} hints. Come back tomorrow for another.

map.title: Archipelago
map.locked_island: Locked — clear level 50 of the previous island. Puzzles in preparation.
map.future_island: In preparation — no validated puzzles yet.
puzzle.objective: Link each source to its egg: same symbol, same number. {n} channels, no crossing.
puzzle.hint_shown: Hint: extend channel {n} along the dashed line.
puzzle.hint_temp: Hint: draw channel {n} first to wake the power. You can redraw it afterwards.
puzzle.hint_remove_title: A channel is in the way
puzzle.hint_remove: Channel {n} (circled) prevents finishing. Remove it? No hint is spent.
puzzle.pause_body: Your progress is saved. No timer, no lives.
tutorial.1: Put your finger on a source (round basin) and slide to the egg with the same number. Release on the egg to confirm.
tutorial.2: Rocks cannot be crossed. Slide back to erase a segment; touch a channel to take it over.
tutorial.3: Channels never cross. The flame is heat energy: each egg only accepts its own pair.
tutorial.4: Stuck? “Undo” goes back one gesture, “Restart” resets the board. Both are free and unlimited.
tutorial.5: The sun is light energy: link the lanterns. The hint shows the next segment — it is free during the tutorial.
tutorial.11: Brindille watches the golden altar. Connect the water pair first: a bridge will grow over the gap.
tutorial.21: Braise waits at the golden altar. Connect the heat pair to melt the ice.
tutorial.31: Nacre sleeps by the golden altar. Connect the light pair to freeze the current and walk across.
hints.none_body: Undo and restart stay free. You can also get a hint without paying: the video is optional.
ads.failed: Video not completed: no reward granted.
ads.mock.title: Simulated rewarded video

win.milestone: A major restoration is unlocked in the garden!

win.slice_done: You have cleared every level available in this prototype.
